mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4.0% with a 3-month cumulative drop exceeding 0.25 percentage points signals an accommodative monetary policy shift that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of observations where FEDFUNDS has declined by ≥0.25pp over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly federal funds rate increase above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that elevates equity risk premiums, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% in the current month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increase above 4.3% and private employment decline exceeding 50k in the same month indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE > 4.3 and PAYEMS decline >50k fails to predict negative 60-day returns in >60% of cases (positive returns >60% of instances).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle regimes with consumer spending (RSAFS) above 750,000 million dollars and housing starts (HOUST) above 1,600 thousand units, the S&P 500 underperforms as economic peaks approach, yielding negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In periods where RSAFS > 750000 and HOUST > 1600, SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profit growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of observations when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate rise above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that dampens consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when UNRATE has been above 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous consumer spending (RSAFS) decline below 700,000 million dollars and housing market contraction (HOUST) below 1,400 thousand units signal broad-based demand weakness that reduces corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS < 700000 and HOUST < 1400 fails to predict negative 20-day returns in >60% of cases (positive returns >60% of instances).

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL index above 320), a federal funds rate decline signals policy response to inflation that temporarily reduces recession fears, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 320 and FEDFUNDS declines by ≥0.25pp, SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of cases.
